note: Page structures. landing = public pages that must persuade; screens = recurring in-product views. sections run top to bottom; cta says where the primary action sits; proof says what evidence the page needs before it asks; avoid_when names when the pattern misleads or underperforms. product-types.json points at these ids through landing and screens.

patterns.name: Problem, solution, proof
sections: how the product solves it (3 steps or 3 capabilities)
proof: customer logos with a quote or a number
patterns.cta: header button plus one repeat after proof; same label both times
patterns.proof: named customer quote or a measured result, not a logo wall alone
patterns.avoid_when: the reader already knows the category and only compares prices

patterns.name: Product tour by capability
sections: hero visual of the real interface
one section per capability, alternating image and text
patterns.cta: header plus end of page; a secondary 'see docs' link for technical buyers
patterns.proof: real screenshots and a usage number; docs link for developers
patterns.avoid_when: more than five capabilities; group them or the page becomes a feature list

patterns.name: Plans and comparison
sections: headline stating who each plan is for
billing period toggle with the saving in words
plan cards (three at most, one marked as most chosen)
patterns.cta: one button per plan card; the table repeats the buttons in a sticky header row
patterns.proof: total price including tax or fees, renewal terms, refund policy
patterns.avoid_when: price depends entirely on a sales call; show a range or a worked example instead

patterns.name: Waitlist or pre-launch
sections: headline with the promise and the launch window
three-line explanation or a short visual
patterns.cta: the email field itself, above the fold; nothing else competes
patterns.proof: founder name or backing, not invented signup counts
patterns.avoid_when: the product is live; a waitlist for an available product reads as artificial scarcity

patterns.name: Lead capture for a considered purchase
sections: short form (five fields or fewer) beside the copy
security and compliance badges with links
patterns.cta: form visible on first screen on desktop; sticky button on mobile that scrolls to the form
patterns.proof: case study with a named company and a number; certifications that can be verified
patterns.avoid_when: self-serve signup is possible; a demo gate slows buyers who are ready

patterns.name: Storefront home
sections: current campaign or season (one, not a carousel of five)
featured categories as large image tiles
bestsellers grid with price and rating
patterns.cta: add to bag on every product card; search always reachable
patterns.proof: ratings with counts, delivery and returns terms in plain words
patterns.avoid_when: the catalogue has fewer than ten items; use a product-led page instead

patterns.name: Single product story
sections: hero image of the product in use
price and buy button in the first screen
patterns.cta: buy button in the hero and a sticky bar after the first scroll
patterns.proof: independent reviews and the warranty terms
patterns.avoid_when: buyers need to compare variants side by side; use storefront

patterns.name: Content-first home
sections: lead story or most useful article
latest articles in a scannable list
newsletter signup between sections, not as an entry modal
patterns.cta: subscribe; placed after the reader has read something
patterns.proof: author names, dates and corrections policy
patterns.avoid_when: the site sells one product; content belongs on a blog subpage

patterns.name: Professional or regulated service
sections: primary task links (book, call, find a branch, check status)
how it works and what it costs
patterns.cta: the main task (book, call, apply) in the header and the first screen
patterns.proof: licences, registration numbers, real staff photos, reviews from a third party
patterns.avoid_when: never avoided for regulated services; adapt the tone rather than dropping the proof

patterns.name: Work showcase
sections: selected work as large tiles with client and outcome
case study pages with problem, process, result
patterns.cta: contact or enquiry, repeated after the work
patterns.proof: client names and outcomes on each case study
patterns.avoid_when: the work cannot be shown (NDA); lead with services and testimonials instead

patterns.name: Event or ticketing
sections: name, date, place and time zone in the first screen
patterns.cta: register or buy in the first screen and a sticky button on mobile
patterns.proof: past attendance, named speakers, refund terms
patterns.avoid_when: dates are not fixed; use waitlist

patterns.name: Mobile app download
sections: headline and device frame showing the main screen
three core moments, each with a screen
patterns.cta: store badges in the hero and at the end; a QR code on desktop
patterns.proof: store rating with count, privacy label summary
patterns.avoid_when: the main job also works on the web; offer the web path first

patterns.name: Mission and donation
sections: the cause in one sentence with a real photograph
what a gift achieves, in concrete amounts
patterns.cta: donate in the header and after the impact numbers; amounts pre-set but editable
patterns.proof: audited accounts, registration number, how money is split
patterns.avoid_when: never use guilt countdowns or fake matching deadlines

patterns.name: Dashboard home
sections: page title with date range and filters
three to five KPI tiles with unit, period and comparison
table of items that need attention
patterns.cta: the most common next action on the attention table; filters persist in the URL
patterns.proof: data freshness timestamp and source
patterns.avoid_when: users come for one task; land them on that task instead

patterns.name: List and detail
sections: sortable list or table with sticky header
bulk actions bar when rows are selected
detail panel or page with the record
patterns.cta: primary action on the detail view; bulk actions only after selection
patterns.proof: row count and active filters always visible
patterns.avoid_when: fewer than ten records; show cards or a single page

patterns.name: First-run onboarding
sections: one question per step, three to five steps
first useful result before any upsell
patterns.cta: continue button in the same place on every step
patterns.proof: say why each question is asked
patterns.avoid_when: the product works without setup; let people start and ask later

patterns.name: Checkout
sections: order summary with total including tax and delivery
confirmation with order number and next steps
patterns.cta: pay button states the amount; one per step
patterns.proof: security, returns and contact visible near payment
patterns.avoid_when: never pre-tick add-ons or hide fees until the last step

patterns.name: Settings and account
sections: grouped navigation (account, notifications, billing, security, data)
save state per section, or autosave with confirmation
danger zone at the end, separated
patterns.cta: save per section; destructive actions confirm by typing or offer undo
patterns.proof: show current plan, usage and renewal date
patterns.avoid_when: fewer than six settings; keep them inline where they apply

patterns.name: Conversation or assistant
sections: composer fixed at the bottom with attach and send
suggested starts for an empty thread
stop, retry and edit controls on generated replies
patterns.cta: send; stop replaces send while a reply streams
patterns.proof: sources and timestamps on answers that depend on them
patterns.avoid_when: the task is a form with known fields; a chat adds steps

patterns.name: Editor or canvas
sections: top bar with file name, save state and share
context panel for the selected object
patterns.cta: share or export in the top bar; save is automatic and visible
patterns.proof: save status and version history
patterns.avoid_when: users only fill a template; give a form

patterns.name: Feed
sections: posts with author, time and actions
load more or paginate with position kept
end-of-feed message rather than endless scroll
patterns.cta: compose; reactions sized as full touch targets
patterns.proof: report and block controls on every post
patterns.avoid_when: content is reference material; use list-detail

patterns.name: Booking or scheduling
sections: choose date and time with availability shown
patterns.cta: confirm booking with date, time and price in the label
patterns.proof: time zone, cancellation deadline and contact
patterns.avoid_when: only one slot type and one resource; a direct form is shorter

patterns.name: Media player
sections: play, pause, seek and volume reachable by keyboard and touch
mini player that persists across navigation
patterns.cta: play; autoplay of the next item can be turned off
patterns.proof: captions available and labelled
patterns.avoid_when: never autoplay with sound
